programs.title: Live: Beyond the buzz: What do young Americans really think about China-US relations?
programs.desc: What happens when young Americans experience China beyond the headlines? Join CGTN for a candid conversation with US creators and students living in China as they share firsthand perspectives on daily life, consumer trends, innovation, and how these experiences are reshaping their understanding of China's economic dynamism and China-US connections.

programs.title: Around China: Explore Lijiang's vibrant nighttime economy with Naxi culture
programs.desc: In recent years, Lijiang, Yunnan Province, has been leveraging its unique local resources to enrich and elevate its nighttime economy. By promoting activities such as nighttime dining, scenic views, and evening performances, Lijiang has unleashed vibrant consumer energy, attracting a growing number of tourists. Join CGTN Reporter Zhu Zhu to immerse in the Naxi ethnic wear, taking part in a bonfire party at Sifang Street, and explore Lijiang’s nighttime economy firsthand.
